title: PostReady: PR #604 — Fix multi-scene video captions cover the whole video
description: Fixed multi-scene video captions which were not covering the full video duration. Captions now span the entire video correctly (PR #600 follow-up).

title: PostReady: PR #603 — Review-to-post quote-card builder
description: Added a review-to-post quote-card builder that turns client reviews into branded, social-ready quote cards, making it easy to convert testimonials into polished posts.

title: PostReady: PR #602 — Fix multi-scene video Cloudflare subrequest limit via fal webhooks
description: Fixed multi-scene video generation which was failing due to Cloudflare's 50 subrequest limit. Switched scene rendering to fal webhooks instead of direct calls.

title: PostReady: PR #601 — Fix captions to expand on-image text, not describe the artwork
description: Fixed a bug where text-on-image posts got captions describing the visual design instead of expanding on the on-image message.

title: PostReady: PR #599 — Trim dashboard header + six rotating hero lines
description: Dashboard header trimmed for cleaner UX, and the landing page hero now cycles through six rotating headline variants.

title: PostReady: PR #598 — Snap→Post: camera button, HEIC→JPEG, photo-first mobile
description: Added a Take a Photo button (mobile-only) opening device camera directly. Added HEIC→JPEG conversion to fix iPhone photo upload failures.

title: PostReady: PR #597 — Stream dashboard shell, fold billing into profile query
description: getProfile() now fetches plan status and subscription data together, eliminating a serial Supabase round trip before the dashboard shell streams.

title: PostReady: PR #595 — Write another caption button
description: Added a Write another caption button so users can regenerate captions inline without restarting the creation flow.

title: PostReady: PR #594 — Fix metrics collector IG reach call + Graph error visibility
description: Fixed the Instagram metrics collector — IG reach API call corrected and Graph API errors surfaced with visibility.

title: PostReady: PR #593 — Onboarding requires business name + auto-generates first post
description: Onboarding now requires a business name before proceeding, and automatically generates the first post during setup to reduce time-to-value.
